title: Effect Proposal v1
description: Non-authoritative proposal layer for model-generated tool/effect intents. This object represents intent only and confers zero execution permission or authorization.

schema_version.description: Semantic type identity. Distinct from CapabilityPayloadV1 binary revisions.

proposed_effect_type.description: The categorical consequence desired by the model. Does not map directly to a capability type.

target_resource.description: Opaque handle or intended target. Resource interpretation is strictly deferred to the host authority layer.

parameters.description: Flexible payload for the proposed effect. Validation occurs during host capability translation, not at the proposal boundary.

reasoning.description: Optional model explanation or evidence. Does not constitute authorization rationale.
